title: Drishyam 3 Jumps 150% on Sixth Monday, Nears Profitability Milestone
excerpt: Ajay Devgn's Hindi thriller reached ₹380.07 crore net in India after 39 days, leaving it ₹1.52 crore short of the mark Koimoi sets for it to become 2026's third most profitable Hindi film.
body:
• Drishyam 3: The Conclusion, the Hindi crime thriller starring Ajay Devgn, jumped about 150% on its sixth Monday (day 39) to roughly ₹20 lakh, up from about ₹8 lakh the previous day, according to Koimoi.
  • After 39 days the film stands at ₹380.07 crore net in India and ₹593.42 crore gross worldwide, including ₹144.89 crore from overseas markets.
  • Koimoi calculates the film needs ₹381.59 crore net to match Awarapan 2's 246.90% return-on-investment benchmark — exactly ₹1.52 crore away — and become the third most profitable Hindi film of 2026.
  • The film, made on a reported budget of ₹110 crore, is in what is likely its final week in Indian theatres, with its overseas run already wrapped up.

Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3: The Conclusion is ending its theatrical run the way it spent much of it — refusing to lie down. The Hindi-language crime thriller earned almost ₹20 lakh on its sixth Monday, day 39 of its run, a jump of about 150% over the previous day's roughly ₹8 lakh, according to Koimoi's box office tracking. The post-Diwali bump took its cumulative India net collection to ₹380.07 crore in 39 days.

The Milestone Within Reach

The number that now matters for the Abhishek Pathak-directed film is not a round crore figure but a ranking. Koimoi ranks Drishyam 3 as the fourth most profitable Hindi film of 2026, behind Hanuman Ansh, Dhurandhar 2 and Awarapan 2. To match the 246.90% return-on-investment benchmark set by Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2, Drishyam 3 — made on a reported budget of ₹110 crore — needs to reach ₹381.59 crore net in India. At ₹380.07 crore, it is ₹1.52 crore short, with its sixth week expected to be its last in Indian theatres and fresh competition from Ramayana, which released on November 5.

The Run So Far

Released on October 2, 2026, the third film in the Drishyam series stars Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar, alongside Tabu, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Jaideep Ahlawat, Rajat Kapoor and Prakash Raj. Its worldwide gross stands at ₹593.42 crore, made up of ₹448.53 crore gross in India and ₹144.89 crore overseas — just under a quarter of the total coming from international markets, including North America. By day 37 the film had already crossed ₹587 crore worldwide, more than double the ₹239.83 crore grossed by Mohanlal's Malayalam version of Drishyam 3, according to The Times of India's day-37 report citing Sacnilk.

What to Watch

Daily collections are now measured in lakhs, not crores, so the remaining question is arithmetic: whether the film's final days add the ₹1.52 crore that would move it past Awarapan 2 on Koimoi's profitability table before its run closes. All box office figures here are trade estimates compiled by Koimoi and Sacnilk from public and industry sources, not studio-reported numbers. For diaspora viewers who missed it in theatres, no streaming release date has been announced in the sources tracking the run.
